role: Wildcard folder concept for native Blender reconstruction
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a compact polished 3D metallic logo concept for Ferralk, a file finder and glob-pattern matcher, to reconstruct faithfully in Blender. The reference is the approved Ferrolink sibling logo: match its warm polished steel and rich brown copper, elegant machined bevels, genuine metal reflections, shallow sculptural depth and transparent background. Do not copy the chain subject.
Create exactly ONE substantial polished silver-steel FILE FOLDER, with a broad flat face and a small recognizable raised index tab along its upper left silhouette. A large SIX-ARMED ASTERISK wildcard symbol is inlaid or mounted on its face in rich warm copper. The asterisk has six thick, straight, blunt-ended arms at equal angles, visibly like the glob wildcard *, never a five-pointed favorite star, snowflake, flower or gear. It should occupy about 65 percent of the folder face and remain bold at 32 pixels. The folder and wildcard together express searching or selecting files by a pattern. No other nodes, network connectors, branching diagram, document text or objects. The folder is one simple solid manufactured form, not a stack of catalog sheets.
Compact nearly square visible mass; the substantial steel face fills the icon, with generous copper asterisk arms and a broad clean silver margin. A narrow dark graphite rear edge reveals construction without an external L-shaped frame. Shallow three-quarter view, slightly turned so the real thickness and broad reflections are visible, never strongly foreshortened. Polished silver face with dark-to-light softbox gradients, rich brown copper with crisp warm highlights and darker side faces, clean rounded machined rims. No flat matte slabs, no pure white face, no pink copper, screws, tiny details, text, letters, wordmark, watermark, containing app tile, floor or backdrop. One complete centered object with clear transparent padding and a genuinely transparent alpha background.
